def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] in (1,2)]
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts if g[pts[0][0]][pts[0][1]]==1 else pts[::-1]
    dr,dc=r2-r1,c2-c1; out=[r[:] for r in g]
    sr=1 if dr>0 else -1; sc=1 if dc>0 else -1
    cells=[]; i,j=r1,c1
    if abs(dc)>=abs(dr):
        while i!=r2-sr: i,j=i+sr,j+sc; cells.append((i,j))
        k=j+sc
        while k!=c2: cells.append((i,k)); k+=sc
    else:
        while j!=c2-sc: i,j=i+sr,j+sc; cells.append((i,j))
        k=i+sr
        while k!=r2: cells.append((k,j)); k+=sr
    for (i,j) in cells: out[i][j]=3
    return out
